priority: P1 — verify classic-owned TagDuel acceptance rollback, per-seat active deck ownership, and physical-seat draw routing across all four initial rotations.

implementation.behavior: A classic-owned lobby refuses consent when one participant has no active valid deck and rolls back the seat lock/deck-row mutation; after a valid deck is activated, the lobby starts without changing player_cards, starter_grants, deck definitions or deck_cards. Four initial-seat rotations then verify that each physical seat retains only its own deck/hand/Extra UIDs and that each End Phase draw comes from the next physical member's own deck.
implementation.validation: Temporary SQLite; createPlayer/chooseStarterDeck/decks.openDeck/decks.activateDeck; createTagLobby/acceptTag; createTagDuel/tagInventory/tagMemberHand/tagActions/stepTagDuel; Discord public/private payload builders and validation.

limitations: Starter collections/decks are prepared as fixtures inside a temporary SQLite database before the no-mutation snapshot; the TagDuel lobby and rotation path must leave those rows unchanged.
Discord builders and payload validation run offline; no live guild, token or production bot session.
This is a TagDuel ownership/rules integration test, not a new card-effect implementation and does not certify a new card.
